description.en:
Instance ID.<props="china"><ph>You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

><notice>
- If an ID exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the invocation fails.
- If no ID exists, you do not need to specify it.

></notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

description.zh:
物联网平台为消息生成的唯一标识ID。

您可登录[物联网平台控制台](http://iot.console.aliyun.com/)，在**监控运维 > 日志服务**页面，获取消息ID信息。
description.en:
The unique identifier (UUID) assigned by IoT Platform to the message.

You can log on to the [IoT Platform console](http://iot.console.aliyun.com/) and obtain the message ID on the **Monitoring and O&M > Simple Log Service** page.

title.zh: 查询设备上下行消息的详情
title.en: Query details of device mobile originated and mobile terminated messages

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
QoS=0和QoS=1消息的最大存储时间分别为1天和7天。调用本接口前，请确认查询的是存储时间内的消息。否则，查询消息会失败。

## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。

> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## How-To  
Messages with QoS=0 and QoS=1 are stored for a maximum of 1 Day and 7 Days, respectively. Before calling this API, confirm that you are querying messages within their storage period. Otherwise, the query will fail.

## queries per second (QPS) limit  
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account calling this API is 10.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
